			-- MY MODEL 확인		
			SELECT @v_myModel_chk = @v_myModel_chk + COUNT(*)

 		    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE	SMS
				    ON SMS.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
			       AND SMS.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE

			LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
			WHERE A.DIVISION_ID= @v_division_id
			AND A.FROM_SITE	= @v_from_site

			AND A.VALID_YN	= 'Y'
			AND A.USER_ID = @p_approval_id;

			--FROM SSP_MST_MODEL_USER A WITH(NOLOCK)
			--JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID
			--LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID

			--AND A.ITEM_ID	= @v_item_id
			--AND A.VALID_YN	= 'Y'
			--AND A.USER_ID = @p_approval_id;
		END
		

		SET @mst_loop_cnt = 0;
			
		WHILE LEN(@p_main_confirm_id) > 0 AND @mst_loop_cnt < @max_loop_cnt
		BEGIN
			SET @mst_loop_cnt = @mst_loop_cnt + 1;
			SET @v_main_confirm_id = [dbo].[SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL](@p_main_confirm_id, @v_delimiter , @mst_loop_cnt) ;  
			SET @v_division_id = [dbo].[SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL](@p_division_id, @v_delimiter , @mst_loop_cnt) ;
			SET @v_from_site = [dbo].[SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL](@p_from_site, @v_delimiter , @mst_loop_cnt) ;

			SET @v_change_req_no = [dbo].[SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL](@p_change_req_no, @v_delimiter , @mst_loop_cnt) ;

			BEGIN  

				/*GSCM 접속자의 'ADMIN', 'SCM PI Admin' 권한 확인 및 결재자의 권한 확인
				   1.요청자와 승인자가 동일할때 My model일 경우만 승인자 지정 가능
				   2.요청자와 승인자가 동일하지 않을때 My model 또는 SSP Planner 권한만 승인자 지정 가능
				   3.GSCM 접속자의 권한이 'ADMIN', 'SCM PI Admin' 일 경우 승인자 임의 지정 가능
				   
				*/
				IF @p_request_id = @p_approval_id 
					BEGIN
						IF @v_myModel_chk = 0 
							BEGIN
								IF @p_auth != 'ADMIN' AND @p_auth != 'SCM PI Admin'
									THROW 60001, 'Unauthorized', 1;  -- ERROR 발생 시켜 UI에서 사용함 	
							END	
					END
				ELSE IF @p_approval_id != ''
					BEGIN
						IF @v_myModel_chk = 0 
							BEGIN
								IF @v_DefaultGroupId != 'SSP Planner'
									BEGIN
										--IF @p_auth != 'ADMIN' AND @p_auth != 'SCM PI Admin'
										IF @v_DefaultGroupId != 'ADMIN' AND @v_DefaultGroupId != 'SCM PI Admin'
											THROW 60001, 'Unauthorized', 1;  -- ERROR 발생 시켜 UI에서 사용함 	
									END

									
							END	
					END

			END
			
			IF @mst_loop_cnt > 0 
				BEGIN
					IF @p_change_type = 'P'
						BEGIN
							
							SET @v_chk = 0;
							SELECT @v_chk = CASE WHEN ISNULL(ATTRIBUTE1,'') = '' OR ATTRIBUTE1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
							FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM WITH(NOLOCK)
							WHERE CONFIRM_ID = @v_main_confirm_id;
							
							IF @v_chk = 0
								BEGIN
									SET @p_new_confirm_id = 'C'+CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) + RIGHT('000000' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, NEXT VALUE FOR SEQ1_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_ID),6)
									UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
										SET SHIPMENT_STATUS = @p_ship_status
											,CHANGE_REQ_NO = @v_change_req_no
											,ATTRIBUTE1 = @p_new_confirm_id
											,LAST_UPDATED_BY = @p_last_updated_by
											,LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @v_last_update_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)
									WHERE CONFIRM_ID = @v_main_confirm_id;
								END
							ELSE
								BEGIN
									UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
										SET SHIPMENT_STATUS = @p_ship_status
											,LAST_UPDATED_BY

= @p_last_updated_by
											,LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @v_last_update_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)
									WHERE CONFIRM_ID = @v_main_confirm_id;
								END
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
							   SET SHIPMENT_STATUS = @p_ship_status
								  ,CHANGE_REQ_NO = @v_change_req_no
								  ,LAST_UPDATED_BY = @p_last_updated_by
								  ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @v_last_update_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)
							WHERE CONFIRM_ID = @v_main_confirm_id;
						END

						--Shipment Request Info Insert(SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ)
						BEGIN			
							MERGE INTO [dbo].[SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ] A
							USING (
									SELECT 
										@v_change_req_no	as change_req_no
									) B
							ON(
										A.change_req_no  = B.change_req_no
								)
							WHEN MATCHED THEN
									UPDATE SET 
											CHANGE_REQ_STATUS			= @p_change_status
											,REQUEST_TITLE				= @p_title
											,APPROVAL_USER				= @p_approval_id
											,APPROVAL_DEPT				= @p_approval_dept_id
											,CHANGE_REASON_CODE			= @p_change_reason
											,CHANGE_REASON_DETAIL		= @p_reason_detail
											,LAST_UPDATED_BY			= @p_last_updated_by		   
											,LAST_UPDATE_DATE			= @v_last_update_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)	
											,REQUEST_TIME               = @v_last_update_date
							WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
									INSERT (	CHANGE_REQ_NO
											,CHANGE_REQ_STATUS
											,DIVISION_ID
											,FROM_SITE
											,REQUEST_TITLE
											,REQUEST_USER
											,REQUEST_DEPT
											,REQUEST_TIME
											,APPROVAL_USER
											,APPROVAL_DEPT
											,APPROVAL_TIME
											,CHANGE_REASON_CODE
											,CHANGE_REASON_DETAIL
											,REJECT_REASON
											,VALID_YN
											,CHANGE_TYPE
											,CREATED_BY
											,CREATION_DATE
											,LAST_UPDATED_BY
											,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
											,ELECTRODE_YN
											,ELECTRODE_TYPE
											,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
											,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
										)
									VALUES (	@v_change_req_no
											  , @p_ship_status
											  , @p_division_id
											  , @p_from_site
											  , @p_title
											  , @p_request_id
											  , @p_request_dept_id
											  , @v_last_update_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)
											  , @p_approval_id
											  , @p_approval_dept_id
											  , NULL
											  , @p_change_reason
											  , @p_reason_detail
											  , NULL
											  ,'Y'
											  , @p_change_type
											  , @p_last_updated_by
											  , @v_last_update_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)
											  , @p_last_updated_by
											  , @v_last_update_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)
											  , substring(@p_electrode_yn,0, CHARINDEX('^',@p_electrode_yn)) --@p_electrode_yn
											  , substring(@p_electrode_type,0, CHARINDEX('^',@p_electrode_type)) --@p_electrode_type
											  , substring(@p_origin_from_division_id,0, CHARINDEX('^',@p_origin_from_division_id)) --@p_origin_from_division_id
											  , substring(@p_origion_to_division_id,0, CHARINDEX('^',@p_origion_to_division_id)) --@p_origion_to_division_id
										);
						END


				END
		END
	
		COMMIT;

		IF @p_change_status = 'Q'
		--출하확정변경시 ERP 전송 이터 테이블 저장 C: 변경요청
			BEGIN
				--메일 발송
				 EXEC SCM_SSP_MAIL_SEND @v_change_req_no, @p_change_status
			END
	
		SET @v_log_type = 'END';
		SET @v_log_message = '########## END of procedure ##########';
		SET @v_description = '';
		SET @d_event_date = @v_last_update_date;--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone);
		EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;
			
		-- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
		SELECT  'S' AS result_code, @v_change_req_no Request_no ;

	 END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH

		  ROLLBACK TRAN; --입력 데이타

롤백 처리

		  IF ERROR_NUMBER() != 60001  -- 자가 승인 제한건은 ERROR 로그 처리 안함.
			  BEGIN
				INSERT INTO scm_sys_log_batch (program_name
											  ,log_type
											  ,log_count
											  ,log_message
											  ,description
											  ,event_date
											  ,creation_date
											  ,created_by
											  ,last_update_date
											  ,last_updated_by)
				VALUES (ERROR_PROCEDURE()
					   ,'ERROR'
					   ,NULL
					   ,ERROR_MESSAGE()
					   ,NULL
					   ,SYSDATETIME()
					   ,SYSDATETIME()
					   ,ERROR_PROCEDURE()
					   ,SYSDATETIME()
					   ,ERROR_PROCEDURE());

				--IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
				  --COMMIT WORK;
			  END;
		
		    -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
			  SELECT 'F' AS result_code;
			  SELECT '[' + Convert(NVARCHAR(10), ERROR_NUMBER()) + ']' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
		
		END CATCH;
END

				--SELECT TRANSPORT_MODE CODE  
			 --    ,TRANSPORT_MODE NAME
				-- ,BOD_ID
				--,ROUTE_ID

				--,D_COUNTRY

				--,A_COUNTRY

				--,TO_CITY

				--AND division_id = @v_division_id

				--order by priority
				--;

				--230207 jilee 사용자가 Qty 입력 안하는 경우 있어 예외 처리
				IF ISNULL(@v_shipment_qty,'') = ''
				BEGIN
						
					SELECT 'Q' AS result_code;
					SET @v_log_type = 'END';
					SET @v_log_message = '########## END of procedure ##########';
					SET @v_description = 'Shipment Qty Empty Value';
					SET @d_event_date = SYSDATETIME();
						
					EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;

					RETURN;
						
				END 

				SELECT TOP 1
					 @v_division_id		   = V.DIVISION_ID 
					,@v_new_bod_id		   = V.BOD_ID 
					,@v_from_site		   = V.FROM_SITE
					,@v_to_site			   = V.TO_SITE 
					,@v_new_incoterms      = V.SSP_INCOTERMS
					,@v_new_transport_mode = V.TRANSPORT_MODE
					,@v_new_route_id	   = V.ROUTE_ID 
					,@v_new_d_contry	   = V.D_COUNTRY        
					,@v_new_d_port_code    = V.D_PORT_CODE      
					,@v_new_a_country      = V.A_COUNTRY        
					,@v_new_a_port_code    = V.A_PORT_CODE      
					,@v_new_customer_lt    = V.LT_TOTAL      
					,@v_new_to_country     = V.TO_COUNTRY       
					,@v_new_to_city		   = V.TO_CITY

				FROM    (
							SELECT   DISTINCT B.DIVISION_ID , B.BOD_ID , B.FROM_SITE, B.TO_SITE , B.SSP_INCOTERMS, B.TRANSPORT_MODE
									,B.ROUTE_ID, B.D_COUNTRY, B.D_PORT_CODE, B.A_COUNTRY, B.A_PORT_CODE, B.LT_TOTAL, B.LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN, B.TO_COUNTRY, B.TO_CITY , B.PRIORITY, B.bod_valid_yn
							FROM (
									SELECT DIVISION_ID 
									,      BOD_ID
									,      FROM_SITE
									,      TO_SITE 
									,      SSP_INCOTERMS		AS SSP_INCOTERMS
									,      TRANSPORT_MODE 			
									,      SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN  AS SHIP_LT_TOTAL 
									,	   ROUTE_ID
									,      d_country
									,      d_port_code
									,      a_country
									,      a_port_code
									,      lt_total
									,      LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN 
									,	   to_country
									,      to_city
									,      PRIORITY 			
									,      bod_valid_yn
									--FROM SCP_MST_BOD_V WITH(NOLOCK) 
									FROM [DBO].[SCP_MST_BOD_N_V] WITH(NOLOCK) 
									WHERE DIVISION_ID = @v_division_id
									AND   FROM_SITE   = @v_

from_site
									AND   TO_SITE   = @v_to_site
									AND	  TRANSPORT_MODE = @v_new_transport_mode
									AND	  ssp_incoterms = @v_new_incoterms
									AND   BOD_VALID_YN ='Y'				
									AND   FROM_YYYYMMDD <= @v_shipment_date
									AND   TO_YYYYMMDD >= @v_shipment_date

								)  B 
		
				   )  V
				   	JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT 
							A.DIVISION_ID 
							, V.FROM_SITE
							, CASE WHEN ISNULL(B.PACKER_ITEM_ID_SUFFIX,'') = '' THEN A.ITEM_ID ELSE ISNULL(STUFF(A.ITEM_ID,12,1, B.PACKER_ITEM_ID_SUFFIX), A.ITEM_ID)  END  AS ITEM_ID 
							, A.BOD_ID 
						   FROM   SCP_MST_BOD_ITEM  A WITH(NOLOCK) 
						   INNER JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V V WITH(NOLOCK) 
							 ON A.DIVISION_ID =  V.DIVISION_ID
							AND A.BOD_ID	  =  V.BOD_ID
						   INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE	B
							 ON B.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
							AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = V.FROM_SITE
						   WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID =   @v_division_id
							 AND  B.OSP_YN		= 'Y'
						     AND CASE WHEN ISNULL(B.PACKER_ITEM_ID_SUFFIX,'') = '' THEN A.ITEM_ID ELSE ISNULL(STUFF(A.ITEM_ID,12,1, B.PACKER_ITEM_ID_SUFFIX), A.ITEM_ID) END =  @v_item_id 						     
						  )   A
					  ON A.DIVISION_ID  = V.DIVISION_ID 
					 AND A.BOD_ID       = V.BOD_ID

					--JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID , ITEM_ID , BOD_ID 
					--	   FROM   [DBO].[SCP_MST_BOD_ITEM]  WITH(NOLOCK)   -- SCP_MST_BOD_ITEM A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					--	   WHERE  DIVISION_ID =   @v_division_id
					--	   --ITEM 코드 11자리까지 동일하면 유효한 BOD ITEM
					--	   AND    SUBSTRING(ITEM_ID,1,11)  = SUBSTRING(@v_item_id,1,11)

					--  ON A.DIVISION_ID  = V.DIVISION_ID 
					-- AND A.BOD_ID       = V.BOD_ID

				WHERE 1=1
				  AND V.division_id = @v_division_id

				  AND V.to_site = @v_to_site
				  AND V.TRANSPORT_MODE = @v_new_transport_mode

				  AND V.bod_valid_yn = 'Y'
				order by V.PRIORITY


				IF ( (@v_division_id			= '' OR @v_division_id IS NULL				)

					OR (@v_to_site				= '' OR @v_to_site IS NULL			   		)
					OR (@v_new_incoterms		= '' OR @v_new_incoterms IS NULL			)
					OR (@v_new_transport_mode	= '' OR @v_new_transport_mode IS NULL		)
					OR (@v_new_route_id			= '' OR @v_new_route_id IS NULL				)
					OR (@v_new_d_contry			= '' OR @v_new_d_contry IS NULL	 			)
					OR (@v_new_d_port_code		= '' OR @v_new_d_port_code IS NULL	  		)
					OR (@v_new_a_country		= '' OR @v_new_a_country IS NULL	  		)
					OR (@v_new_a_port_code		= '' OR @v_new_a_port_code IS NULL	 		)
					OR (@v_new_customer_lt		= '' OR @v_new_customer_lt IS NULL	 		)
					OR (@v_new_to_country		= '' OR @v_new_to_country IS NULL			)
					OR (@v_new_to_city			= '' OR @v_new_to_city IS NULL				)
					)
					BEGIN
						
						SELECT 'X' AS result_code;

						SET @d_event_date = SYSDATETIME();

						RETURN;
						
					END

										  , @p_user_id

										  , @d_event_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)
										  , @p_user_id

, @p_user_dept_id

						BEGIN

							;
							--SET @v_new_eta_date = convert(VARCHAR(8), dateadd(dd, convert(int, @v_new_customer_lt), convert(datetime,@v_new_etd_date)),112)
							;

					/* 2019.10.29 출발일 기준 항차를 고려한 ETA_DATE 계산*/
					SET @v_new_eta_date = [dbo].[FN_GET_SSP_ETA_DATE](@p_division_id, @v_new_bod_id_temp, @v_shipment_date) 

					INSERT SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_de
					(	
						CHANGE_REQ_NO,								CONFIRM_ID,							NEW_YN,															 DIVISION_ID,
						ITEM_ID,									FROM_SITE,							TO_SITE,														 YYYYMMDD,
						QTY,										BOD_ID,								ROUTE_ID,														 BIZ_TYPE,
						PROJECT_CODE,								FCST_TYPE,							FCST_ETD_DATE,													 FCST_ETA_DATE,

						CUSTOMER_LT,								TO_COUNTRY,							TO_CITY,														 NEW_YYYYMMDD,
						NEW_QTY,									NEW_BOD_ID,							NEW_ROUTE_ID,													 NEW_ETD_DATE,
						NEW_ETA_DATE,								NEW_INCOTERMS,						NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE,												 NEW_D_COUNTRY,
						NEW_D_PORT_CODE,							NEW_A_COUNTRY,						NEW_A_PORT_CODE,												 NEW_CUSTOMER_LT,
						NEW_TO_COUNTRY,								NEW_TO_CITY,						FROM_SITE_TYPE,													 FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID,
						FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID,						FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE,				FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE,											 FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID,

						ERP_DO_NO,									ERP_STATUS,							VALID_YN,														 ATTRIBUTE1,
						CREATED_BY,									CREATION_DATE,						LAST_UPDATED_BY,												 LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
						ELECTRODE_YN,								ELECTRODE_TYPE,						ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID,										 ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID,
						REMARKS,									REMARKS2,							REMARKS3,														 REQUESTOR
						/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

						,PACKAGE_TYPE
						,FACTORY_ID
						,PACKAGE_QTY
						,DOM_EXP
						,ERP_ATTR1
						,ERP_ATTR2
						,ERP_ATTR3

,ERP_ATTR4
						,ERP_ATTR5
					)
					SELECT 
						@v_max_req_no CHANGE_REQ_NO					,A.CONFIRM_ID							,CASE WHEN @p_change_type = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS NEW_YN ,A.DIVISION_ID
						,A.ITEM_ID									,A.FROM_SITE							,A.TO_SITE														,A.YYYYMMDD
						,A.QTY										,A.BOD_ID								,A.ROUTE_ID														,A.BIZ_TYPE
						,A.PROJECT_CODE								,A.FCST_TYPE							,A.FCST_ETD_DATE												,A.FCST_ETA_DATE	
						,A.ETD_DATE									,A.ETA_DATE								,A.INCOTERMS													,A.TRANSPORT_MODE
						,A.D_COUNTRY								,A.D_PORT_CODE							,A_COUNTRY														,A.A_PORT_CODE
						,A.CUSTOMER_LT								,A.TO_COUNTRY							,A.TO_CITY														,@v_shipment_date NEW_YYYYMMDD
						,ISNULL(@v_shipment_qty,0) NEW_QTY			,@v_new_bod_id_temp NEW_BOD_ID	,@v_new_route_id_temp NEW_ROUTE_ID										,@v_new_etd_date NEW_ETD_DATE
						,@v_new_eta_date NEW_ETA_DATE				,@v_new_incoterms_temp NEW_INCOTERMS	,@v_new_transport_mode_temp NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE					,@v_new_d_contry_temp NEW_D_COUNTRY
						,@v_new_d_port_code_temp NEW_D_PORT_CODE	,@v_new_a_country NEW_A_COUNTRY			,@v_new_a_port_code_temp NEW_A_PORT_CODE						,@v_new_customer_lt_temp NEW_CUSTOMER_LT
						,@v_new_to_country_temp NEW_TO_COUNTRY		,@v_new_to_city NEW_TO_CITY 			,A.FROM_SITE_TYPE												,A.FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID	
						,A.FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID						,A.FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE				,A.FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE										,A.FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID
						,A.TO_SITE_TYPE								,A.TO_SITE_PLANT_ID						,A.TO_SITE_VENDOR_ID											,A.TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
						,@v_shipto_code								,A.TO_SITE_COMPANY_ID					,A.ERP_SO_NO													,A.ERP_SO_ITEM_NO
						,A.ERP_DO_NO									,ERP_STATUS							,'Y'															,'Y'
						,@p_user_id CREATED_BY						,@v_create_date							,@p_user_id LAST_UPDATED_BY										,@v_create_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone) LAST_UPDATE_DATE
						,A.ELECTRODE_YN								,A.ELECTRODE_TYPE							,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID										,A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
						,@v_remarks									,@v_remarks2							,@v_remarks3													,A.REQUESTOR
						/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
							2020.06.30 : KBK
							I/F 추가요청으로 인하여 컬럼 추가 전극에서만 사용. DDL 표준을 맞추기 위하여 추가함 
						------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
						,A.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE
						,A.FACTORY_ID
						,CASE WHEN A.ELECTRODE_YN = 'N' THEN ISNULL(@v_shipment_qty,0)
							ELSE CEILING(CASE WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'BX' THEN CEILING(ISNULL(@v_shipment_qty,0) * isnull(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH ,1) ) * isnull(B.BOX_PER_CUT ,1)
 											WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SC' THEN CEILING(ISNULL(@v_shipment_qty,0) * isnull(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH ,1) ) * isnull(B.STEELCRATE_PER_CUT ,1)
 											WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SR' THEN CEILING(ISNULL(@v_shipment_qty,0) * isnull(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH ,1) ) * isnull(B.STEELRACK_PER_CUT ,1)
 										ELSE NULL  END) END  AS PACKAGE_QTY
						,A.DOM_EXP
						,A.ERP_ATTR1
						,A.ERP_ATTR2
						,A.ERP_ATTR3
						,A.ERP_ATTR4
						,A.ERP_ATTR5
					FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM A WITH(NOLOCK)

					LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_MST_SITE_ITEM_EE_V B with(nolock)
												ON  B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID 
												AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE 
												AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID 


					WHERE A.CONFIRM_ID = @v_confirm_id;
				END;	--@v_edit_main = 'Y'	End

				-- ROUTE_ID 변경 시 ETA_DATE 반영하기 위하여 결재와 별개로 Confirm UPDATE 
				IF (@v_new_route_id_temp <> @v_new_route_id )
				BEGIN 
					UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
					SET  
					     ROUTE_ID		= @v_new_route_id_temp
					   , ETA_DATE		= @v_new_eta_date		
					WHERE CONFIRM_ID	= @v_confirm_id;

					--EXEC PR_DM_SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC @v_division_id, @v_confirm_id;

				END

				UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
				SET SHIPMENT_STATUS		= 'D'
					,CHANGE_REQ_NO		= @v_max

_req_no
					,LAST_UPDATED_BY	= @p_user_id
					,LAST_UPDATE_DATE	= @d_event_date--[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)
				WHERE CONFIRM_ID		= @v_confirm_id;

		
				IF @v_active_flag = 'I'
				BEGIN

					UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
					   SET ATTRIBUTE10 = NULL
					  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM

					 AND CONFIRM_ID = @v_confirm_id;

				--ELSE
					--ERP전송 Table(XIF_ERP_SHIP_PLAN_CONFIRM_S_SN) Insert
					--출하확정변경시 ERP 전송 이터 테이블 저장 C: 변경요청

		END;		--While					End


		SET @v_log_type = 'END';
		SET @v_log_message = '########## END of procedure ##########';
		SET @v_description = '';
		SET @d_event_date = SYSDATETIME();
		EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;

		SELECT  'S' AS result_code, @v_max_req_no Request_no ;

	END TRY
